nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native SQLite database header parser, SQLite varint decoder, b-tree page header parser, table leaf and table interior cell parsers, index leaf and index interior cell parsers, SQLite record serial decoder, database page reader, sqlite_schema table-b-tree traversal, bounded table-row decoding, rowid table lookup, standard wp_options option_name/option_value reads from resolved root pages, table leaf overflow payload chain reads for large records, explicit wp_options(option_name) index lookup, automatic UNIQUE autoindex first-column inference from CREATE TABLE SQL when sqlite_schema index rows have null SQL, and automatic PRIMARY KEY autoindex inference that skips rowid-alias INTEGER PRIMARY KEY and WITHOUT ROWID table-primary-key cases.

wordpressScenario: SQLite fallback/read-write inspection tooling for WordPress hosts where the SQLite extension is unavailable, now including bounded wp_options row inspection, large option_value overflow reads, explicit option_name index lookup, UNIQUE autoindex-backed option lookup, and PRIMARY KEY-backed option_name lookup for recovery/import workflows.
nextTask: Port SQLite index comparison features outside the current bounded slice: composite duplicate scans, expression indexes, partial indexes, non-BINARY collations, descending sort order, and full composite-key range scans.
